verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Poke serves a proper llms.txt at https://poke.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a descriptive summary of the product, directly satisfying the story of pointing an agent at agent-oriented docs; the MCP server docs also provide further machine-consumable integration info. Missing for 10: a docs.md alternative (404) and a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable API spec, which would round out full agent-native documentation coverage.
